acquisition method: Acquisition was performed in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode
alkylation reagent: alkylated in the dark with 60 nmol iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: alkylated in the dark with 60 nmol iodoacetamide... alkylated in the dark with 180 nmol iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: digestion with endoproteinase LysC... and then diluted 2-fold with 200 mM ammonium bicarbonate for trypsin digestion
collision energy: Fragment ion spectra were produced via collision-induced dissociation (CID) at normalized collision energy of 35%
fragmentation method: Fragment ion spectra were produced via collision-induced dissociation (CID)
instrument: Samples were analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro-mass spectrometer
ionization type: positive ionization mode with nano spray
The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode with nano spray voltage set at 2.1 kV
labeling: we performed free-label mass spectrometry analyses of M. agalactiae and M. pneumoniae
reduction concentration: reduced with 30 nmol dithiothreitol... reduced with 90 nmol dithiothreitol
